$comment: The widths lint T15 counts a line's {vars} and {PLACEHOLDERS} at, against its max (BUILD_PLAN 10.5, S5), and the samples a batch fills a template line with (10.7: three sample fills). Each width is the most code points the value can have, with where that comes from. A {var} or a {PLACEHOLDER} on a line with no width here fails T15. Read by tools/text.mjs (schemas/text_vars.schema.json); web/js/text.js measure() counts with the widths.

build.$comment: The build id (tools/build.mjs buildInfo): the commit's UTC date, a hyphen and git's short SHA, 7 hex digits or 8 when 7 are ambiguous; dev outside git

day.$comment: The trip's day: at most 60 (schemas/vars.json trip.day)

place.$comment: A place's name (place.<id>): the longest gazetteer name of an M1a scope node a caption can show, Seven Mile Group Site, C.B. Flats Group Site and Horse Head Stock Camp, at 21

elev.$comment: A place's elevation as fmt.ft words it (web/js/fmt.js feet): {ft}, a no-break space and ft, so the scope's highest node, Bogachiel Peak at 5,474 ft, is 8

ft.$comment: A height in feet with a comma every three digits (web/js/fmt.js fmtInt, in fmt.ft): the scope's highest node, Bogachiel Peak at 5,474 ft, is four digits

mi.$comment: Today's mile, one decimal (web/js/fmt.js fmtTenths, in fmt.mile_marker): a day's route stays under 100 miles

peak.$comment: The 10-second render's true peak in dBFS, one decimal (ui/sound.js; dev words)

lufs.$comment: The render's loudest 3-second loudness in LUFS, one decimal (ui/sound.js; dev words)

dsp.$comment: Whether this phone's synthesis matches Node's: match or differs (ui/sound.js; dev words)

state.$comment: A line's state in the line inspector: draft, approved, changed, cut, nowords, dev, place or term, approved the longest (ui/inspect.js; dev words)

len.$comment: A line's length in the line inspector (measure): no line's max reaches 1,000

max.$comment: A line's max in the line inspector: three digits, as len

batch.$comment: A line's batch and its number there in the line inspector, B004 #14, or dev.inspect.none's words (8 code points)

pct.$comment: A percentage's number in fmt.pct and fmt.pct_under (web/js/fmt.js pct): a whole number from 10, one decimal under it, and a Why sheet's exact product at up to two more (8.1, 8.8: 15.25 at C.2's headland, 0.675 at the crevasse)

share.$comment: A share as fmt.pct or fmt.pct_under words it, on a diamond's second line: a fail share up to 70%, a fatal share rounded up (8.1), 16% or <0.1% the widest shown; 6 holds an exact 15.25%

what.$comment: A card's fail word on a diamond's second line (its line's max is 6)

choice.$comment: A choice's label, in the confirm (8.1: 22 characters or fewer)

clean.$comment: The clean band in points, 5 to 97 (8.5)

shaky.$comment: The shaky band in points, 0 to 25 (8.8)

fail.$comment: The fail band in points, 1 to 70 (8.8: p is at least 5)

band.$comment: A band's name in the compass's spoken result (trail.band.*, the black the widest at 9; their max 12), or the fatal band's share of the fails as fmt.pct words it in the Why sheet's arithmetic (100%)

death.$comment: A death roll as fmt.pct words it, 0.1% to 100% (9.5: 2% on an exposed crest)

exact.$comment: The exact fatal share as fmt.pct words it, two decimals at least (8.8: 0.21%), up to 0.675% (web/js/fmt.js exactPct)

fatal.$comment: The fatal share as shown, rounded up (8.1): fmt.pct or fmt.pct_under

time.$comment: A clock time as fmt.clock_am or fmt.clock_pm words it: 12:59 pm the widest

dist.$comment: A distance as fmt.mi words it: under 100 miles a day

h.$comment: A clock time's hour, 1 to 12 (fmt.clock_am, fmt.clock_pm)

mm.$comment: A clock time's minutes, two digits

m.$comment: A span's minutes (fmt.min): an outcome's extra time, under 1,000

q.$comment: The lockbox's question number, 1 to 3 (phases/lockbox.js: the deal is three)

delta.$comment: A span as fmt.min words it, in a pencil row
